title: Senior Product Manager II - Identity & Access Management
description:
Here at Appian, our values of **Intensity** and **Excellence** define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you'll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.



*Own the Identity and Access Management product roadmap and deliver enterprise\-grade authentication features that secure every connection between Appian and the enterprise.*

  


**ABOUT THE TEAM**



The IAM Product team is on a mission to secure every identity, authentication flow, and access point that connects Appian to the enterprise. This team operates with high autonomy and directly influences how global enterprises trust and deploy AI\-Powered Process Automation at scale. Your work will define how millions of users authenticate securely across mission\-critical workflows.

  


**THE OPPORTUNITY**



As enterprises accelerate digital transformation, identity security has become the frontline of platform trust. This role exists because Appian is scaling its authentication and authorization capabilities to meet zero trust demands from the world's most security\-conscious organizations. You will shape how the platform handles federated identity, modern protocols, and seamless user experiences in highly regulated environments.

  



**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



* Lead the end\-to\-end IAM product roadmap, defining priorities that balance enterprise security requirements with developer and end\-user experience
* Partner with Engineering to evaluate, design, and enhance authentication and authorization capabilities including native authentication and support for SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, and federated identity frameworks
* Execute discovery and requirements gathering with enterprise customers to understand identity provider integrations, compliance needs, and zero trust adoption patterns
* Architect product specifications and user stories that translate complex identity protocols into intuitive, scalable platform features
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with Security, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver authentication features that accelerate enterprise adoption
* Analyze product performance metrics, customer feedback, and competitive positioning to continuously improve IAM capabilities and reduce friction in authentication flows
  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**



* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
* 4\+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager with a proven track record of successfully managing products that involve identity and access management
* Deep experience with identity and access management, user authentication, or identity provider software in enterprise environments
* Strong technical proficiency with authentication protocols including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, and federated identity architectures
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver secure, scalable authentication solutions
  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**



* Knowledge of zero trust architecture principles and implementation strategies
* Experience working with cloud identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, or Auth0
* Background in cybersecurity, compliance frameworks, or enterprise security product management
* We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise\-Grade Orchestration environment.

**This role is based at our Chennai office in DLF Downtown Chennai.** **Appian was built on a culture of in\-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to foster that culture and ensure we continue to thrive through shared ideas and teamwork. We believe being in the office provides more opportunities to come together and celebrate working with the exceptional people across Appian.**


**Tools and Resources**


* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department\-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First\-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We'll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee\-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.


**Benefits**



Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family\-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.


**About Appian**



Appian provides AI automation for mission\-critical work. We automate complex processes in large enterprises and governments. Our platform is known for its unique reliability and scale. We've been automating processes for more than 25 years and understand enterprise operations like no one else. For more information, visit appian.com. \[Nasdaq: APPN]



Follow Appian: LinkedIn, Youtube, Instagram, Facebook


*Appian is an equal opportunity employer that strives to attract and retain the best talent. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*


*Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at* *ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com**. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.*

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Summary:**

**Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Job Description**

**Senior Product Manager – AIOps \& Agentic AI (Telecom)**

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India \| **Function:** Product Management \| **Level:** Senior Individual Contributor (IC4 / SPM equivalent)

**About the Role**


VIAVI Solutions is at the forefront of AI\-driven network intelligence, powering the next generation of telecom operations through its **NITRO AIOps platform** — a full\-stack, domain\-agnostic intelligence and automation framework serving Tier\-1 and Tier\-2 operators globally.


We are hiring a **Senior Product Manager – AIOps \& Agentic AI** based in **Chennai** to own the product definition, backlog strategy, and go\-to\-market alignment for our AI/ML and Agentic AI capabilities within the NITRO L8 (AIOps Intelligence Layer) and L9 (Vertical Solutions Layer). This is a high\-visibility role sitting at the intersection of network operations intelligence, multi\-agent AI orchestration, and operator outcome delivery — working closely with solution architects, R\&D, platform engineering, and global field teams.


This role reports to the Director of AIOps Solution Architecture (London/global) and operates as the product authority for the India\-aligned product development function.

**What You Will Own**

**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Define and maintain the product backlog and 2\-quarter rolling roadmap for AIOps Intelligence and Vertical Solutions capabilities across RAN, Core, and Transport domains
* Translate operator pain points (MTTR reduction, NOC automation, root cause analysis, proactive anomaly detection) into structured product requirements — PRDs, PDDs, and user stories — with clear acceptance criteria and operator\-outcome metrics
* Lead product discovery with global field teams and customers to validate feature hypotheses before R\&D commitment
* Drive feature prioritisation using value\-vs\-effort frameworks anchored to operator outcomes, not internal capability milestones

**Agentic AI \& AI/ML Product Definition**

* Own the product definition for Agentic AI capabilities: multi\-agent orchestration workflows, autonomous remediation pipelines, LLM\-assisted root cause analysis, and GenAI interfaces for network operations
* Define human\-in\-the\-loop validation requirements, guardrails, and trust frameworks for autonomous AI features — particularly in safety\-critical network operations contexts
* Partner with R\&D and data science teams to define model evaluation criteria, KPIs, and feedback loops for deployed ML models (anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, traffic forecasting)
* Maintain awareness of emerging frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Model Context Protocol) and assess applicability to platform capabilities

**PDD / PRD Authoring \& Artifact Quality**

* Produce operator\-grade Product Definition Documents (PDDs) and Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) as primary artifacts, anchoring each to a one\-year product goal and a release outcome map
* Ensure full backlog traceability from PRD to sprint\-level user story; drive zero\-gap traceability as a team standard
* Champion agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, AI\-assisted pipelines) as a force multiplier for artifact velocity — with mandatory human validation before any commit

**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Alignment**

* Act as the primary product interface between India\-based R\&D engineering and global solution architecture, PLM, and field teams
* Run structured sprint reviews, backlog refinement sessions, and roadmap alignment meetings with a globally distributed team
* Communicate product decisions, trade\-offs, and release outcomes clearly to senior technical and commercial stakeholders
* Provide market intelligence inputs on Indian operator dynamics (Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL/BBNL) to inform localisation and vertical solution priority

**Go\-to\-Market Support**

* Author customer\-facing product briefs, capability comparisons, and battlecard inputs for AIOps and Agentic AI features
* Support pre\-sales and solution architecture teams with product positioning for Indian operator bids and RFP responses
* Track competitive landscape across AIOps vendors (Dynatrace, Datadog, IBM Instana, NETSCOUT) and synthesise inputs into roadmap decisions

**What You Bring**

**Experience**

* **7–12 years of total experience**, with a minimum of **4 years in product management** (PO or PM) in a B2B technology or telecom domain
* Demonstrable ownership of AI/ML\-powered products from inception to GA release — not just feature contribution
* Experience working within a **global product organisation** with distributed engineering and solution architecture stakeholders
* Prior exposure to **telecom operations environments** — NOC, OSS, network analytics, or network management — strongly preferred; prior operator\-side experience (Jio, Airtel, Vi, Ericsson, Nokia, ZTE, Amdocs, NetCracker) is a differentiator

**Technical Literacy (Required)**

* Working knowledge of **ML operations concepts**: model training pipelines, inference, evaluation metrics, data labelling, and drift monitoring
* Ability to read and critique API specifications, data schemas, and system architecture diagrams — not required to code, but required to engage meaningfully with engineering at a design level
* Familiarity with **AIOps platform capabilities**: event correlation, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, automated remediation, topology mapping
* Understanding of **5G/LTE network domains** at functional level: RAN (gNB, CU/DU split), Core (AMF, SMF, UPF), Transport; sufficient to define domain\-specific vertical solutions without requiring constant domain SME support
* Awareness of agentic AI frameworks and LLM orchestration patterns (RAG, tool use, multi\-agent coordination)

**Technical Literacy (Preferred)**

* Hands\-on experience with agentic tooling: Claude Code, LangChain/LangGraph, n8n, or equivalent — even in personal/prototype context
* Exposure to telemetry and observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, gNMI/gRPC streaming telemetry
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployment patterns: Kubernetes, Helm, containerised microservices

**Soft Skills \& Ways of Working**

* Communicates with precision: produces artifacts that can be handed to engineering without re\-interpretation; does not rely on verbal context to carry written requirements
* Operates with structured autonomy — asks for direction on priorities, not on how to execute
* Comfortable managing ambiguity in a maturing product function; can define process where none exists
* Strong stakeholder influence without authority — particularly with senior R\&D and architecture counterparts
* Intellectually honest: surfaces blockers and trade\-offs proactively; does not manage upward by omission

**Qualifications**

**Dimension**

**Requirement**


Education


B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics \& Communication, or related engineering discipline. MBA from a Tier\-1 institution (IIM, ISB, XLRI, IIMB) is advantageous but not required.


Certifications


CSPO, PSPO, or equivalent Product Owner certification preferred. AWS/GCP/Azure cloud practitioner beneficial.


Languages


Fluent English (written and spoken) — the role involves daily interaction with UK and US\-based stakeholders. Tamil working proficiency advantageous for Chennai\-based operator engagement.

**Why This Role**

* **Platform breadth:** NITRO covers the full network stack (L1–L9\); this role owns the AI intelligence and vertical solution layers — not a feature PM role, but a capability platform ownership role
* **Agentic AI at the frontier:** VIAVI is actively deploying multi\-agent orchestration, LLM\-assisted RCA, and autonomous remediation workflows in live operator environments — this role shapes those product decisions
* **India market significance:** Chennai is a strategic R\&D hub for VIAVI; this hire is part of building a Singapore\-Ireland\-India delivery model with global product authority
* **Cross\-functional influence:** The role interfaces directly with global Solution Architecture, PLM, R\&D, and field leadership — not a back\-office backlog management position
* **Career trajectory:** Natural path to Principal PM / Director of Product for the right candidate within 2–3 years as the India team scales

title: Senior Performance Marketer
description:
Senior Performance Marketing Manager – Meta \& Google Ads

**Location:** Chennai\-Guindy  
**Experience:** 3\+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 per month \+ Performance Incentives

About the Role

We are looking for a **Senior Performance Marketing Manager** who can take complete ownership of paid acquisition and revenue performance across **Meta Ads, Google Ads and PPC**.

This role is ideal for a performance marketer who has experience marketing **high\-ticket education, personal development, coaching, training, webinars, events, masterclasses or digital learning programs**.

You will be responsible for the complete paid marketing journey — from **audience research, campaign strategy and tracking to lead generation, webinar/event registrations, sales conversion, revenue attribution, optimisation and profitable scaling**.

This is a **high\-ownership role**. We are looking for someone who can independently analyse numbers, identify problems, make decisions and take action to improve business outcomes.

**About the Business**

We are a leading **personal and professional development platform** working with renowned coaches, trainers and speakers to create transformational learning experiences.

Our offerings span **live webinars, masterclasses, personal\-growth programs, business and professional\-development programs, summits and large\-scale learning events**. We work with a diverse ecosystem of Indian and international coaches and speakers across areas such as wealth, business, career, personal growth, performance and professional development.

The business operates across both **digital and physical experiences**, making performance marketing an important part of driving registrations, qualified leads, program sales and revenue.

What You Will Own

1\. Paid Acquisition

* Own performance marketing across **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
* Develop paid acquisition strategies for webinars, masterclasses, events, summits and learning programs
* Plan campaign structures based on business objectives, audience segments and funnel stages
* Manage and optimise significant advertising budgets
* Continuously test audiences, creatives, messaging, offers and campaign structures
* Identify winning campaigns and scale them while maintaining profitability

2\. Funnel \& Revenue Performance

* Manage campaigns across the complete customer journey:
* **Ad → Landing Page → Lead/Registration → Webinar/Event → Sales → Revenue**
* Understand and optimise different funnel models including:
* Lead Generation Funnels
* Webinar Funnels
* Event Registration Funnels
* VSL Funnels
* Masterclass Funnels
* High\-Ticket Sales Funnels
* Retargeting Funnels
* Analyse conversion drop\-offs across the funnel
* Work with funnel and sales teams to improve conversion rates
* Optimise campaigns based on **actual sales and revenue**, not simply lead volume3\. Tracking \& Attribution
* Own and maintain accurate conversion tracking across advertising platforms
* Hands\-on experience with:
* **Meta Pixel**
* **Meta Conversion API (CAPI)**
* **Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)**
* **Google Tag Manager (GTM)**
* **Google Ads Conversion Tracking**
* Track the customer journey from advertisement to lead, registration, sale and revenue
* Identify tracking gaps and coordinate with technology/funnel teams to resolve them
* Ensure campaign optimisation is based on reliable data

4\. Audience \& Customer Research

* Develop a strong understanding of the target audience for different programs and events
* Conduct **ICP and audience research**
* Analyse customer intent, pain points, motivations and buying behaviour
* Build and optimise:
* Cold audiences
* Lookalike audiences
* Retargeting audiences
* Website visitors
* Video viewers
* Lead\-based audiences
* Customer\-based audiences
* Understand the complete customer journey from awareness to purchase

5\. Creative Performance

* Work closely with creative, content and marketing teams to develop high\-performing advertisements
* Identify creative patterns that drive better CTR, CPL, CAC and ROAS
* Analyse creative performance and provide clear briefs for new creatives
* Continuously test:
* Hooks
* Angles
* Ad copy
* Videos
* Creatives
* Offers
* Landing\-page messaging
* Build a structured creative testing and scaling process

6\. Budget Management \& Scaling

* Plan and manage campaign budgets based on performance and business targets
* Identify opportunities to increase spend on profitable campaigns
* Scale winning campaigns without unnecessarily increasing CAC
* Reallocate budgets based on performance
* Understand the relationship between **spend, leads, sales, CAC, revenue and ROAS**
* Balance growth and profitability while scaling

7\. Reporting \& Decision Making

* Prepare weekly performance reports covering:
* Ad Spend
* Leads
* Qualified Leads
* Registrations
* Sales
* Revenue
* CPL
* CAC
* CPA
* ROAS
* Conversion Rate
* Clearly identify:
* **What happened → Why it happened → What needs to change → What will be done next**
* Present actionable insights rather than simply sharing dashboards
* Take ownership of performance improvement based on dataMandatory Requirements
* **3\+ years of hands\-on Performance Marketing experience**
* Experience managing **₹3 Crore\+ cumulative advertising spend**
* Strong hands\-on expertise in **Meta Ads and Google Ads/PPC**
* Proven experience in **Lead Generation and Conversion\-focused campaigns**
* Experience with **Education, Coaching, Training, Personal Development, Events, Webinars or similar businesses**
* Experience working with **Webinar, VSL, Event Registration, Masterclass or Sales Funnels**
* Strong understanding of **CAC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, Revenue and Conversion Rate**
* Hands\-on experience with **Meta Pixel, CAPI, GA4, GTM and conversion tracking**
* Experience integrating landing pages, CRM systems and marketing automation
* Strong understanding of **audience research, ICP, retargeting and customer journeys**
* Proven ability to manage significant budgets and scale profitable campaigns
* Ability to analyse campaign performance based on **sales and revenue**, not just leads
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of performance

What Will Make You Stand Out

You will be a strong fit if you have:

* Managed **high\-ticket education, coaching or personal\-development campaigns**
* Worked on **webinar or event registration funnels**
* Managed campaigns where leads move through a **CRM → Sales Team → Purchase** journey
* Experience scaling campaigns from smaller budgets to significant monthly spends
* A proven track record of improving **CAC and ROAS while increasing revenue**
* Experience running campaigns across multiple products, programs or events
* Experience working with large audiences and nationwide campaigns
* Strong understanding of both **marketing metrics and business/revenue metrics**
* The ability to connect advertising performance with actual business outcomes

Key KPIs

You will be primarily accountable for:

**Revenue \| CAC \| ROAS \| Qualified Leads \| Sales \| CPL \| CPA \| Conversion Rate \| Budget Utilisation \| Profitable Scaling**

Who Should NOT Apply

Please do not apply if:

* Your experience is mainly limited to boosting posts
* You have only handled basic campaign setup
* You know Meta Ads but cannot independently manage Google Ads/PPC
* You optimise only for CPL and lead volume
* You have no understanding of CAC, sales, revenue or ROAS
* You have never worked with funnels
* You have no hands\-on experience with Pixel, CAPI, GA4 or GTM
* You cannot demonstrate the advertising spend you have managed
* You cannot explain the results generated from your campaigns
* You require continuous instructions to optimise campaigns
* You are uncomfortable being accountable for performance and revenue

What We Expect

This is **not a campaign\-execution role**.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a **performance owner**, not simply an ad operator.

You should be able to look at the numbers and independently answer:

**Where are we losing money?**  
**Which campaigns are working?**  
**Which audiences are converting?**  
**Which creatives should we scale?**  
**Why is CAC increasing?**  
**Where is the funnel leaking?**  
**What should we change today?**  
**How can we scale revenue profitably?**

You will work closely with **creative, content, funnel, sales, CRM, technology and leadership teams** to improve the overall customer acquisition engine.

The mindset we are looking for:

**Ownership → Analyse → Test → Optimise → Scale → Measure → Repeat**

If you are someone who enjoys working with numbers, solving performance problems and building campaigns that generate **real revenue**, we would like to hear from you.

Compensation

**₹30,000 – ₹50,000 fixed per month \+ performance\-based incentives**

Higher compensation can be considered for exceptional candidates who can demonstrate strong experience in managing and scaling **high\-spend campaigns with measurable revenue and profitability outcomes**.

Application Requirement

Candidates should be prepared to discuss:

* Total cumulative ad spend managed
* Highest monthly ad spend handled
* Platforms managed
* Types of funnels handled
* Best CAC / CPL / ROAS achieved
* Revenue generated through paid campaigns
* Examples of campaigns successfully scaled
* Tracking and attribution systems implemented
* A specific example where you identified a performance problem and independently solved it

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Vice President - Relationship Manager - Business Banking
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 **Business Descriptor:**

  

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) – Business Banking provides customized one\-stop financial solutions to prime small and medium\-sized businesses.


For customers conducting business locally or around the world, we offer a comprehensive range of transaction banking services including Trade Remittances , cash management and treasury services. As a reliable financial partner, we attend to the specific business needs of our customers and provide efficient tailor\-made banking solutions through our relationship managers and dedicated specialists.


We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as **VP \& Relationship Manager , Business Banking based at Chennai**

 **Principal responsibilities**

  

* Originate New to Bank accounts , manage and monitor a portfolio of SME customers by extending appropriate transaction banking facilities
* Originate global payment solutions /Trade Processing/FX transactions from SME / Emerging Corporate clients, mainly from Digital First Companies, local IT/ITES firms and MNC subsidiaries. Onboard these clients with a solutions\-based approach, developing unique solutions wherever required.
* Meet or exceed the business target on annual portfolio revenue , asset book growth , with focus in PSL and EXIM client segments
* Build Liquid Asset OR Cash / SBLC , backed Lending (credit assessment memo
* Develop deep relationships with PE/VC funds and Incubators to provide cash and trade solutions to their investee companies. Extend these influencer relationships to renowned law firms \& Chartered Accounts as well.
